title: feat(app-shell): an app page reads its bound row as `record` (objectui#12931)
body:
Fixes #12931
Clause-②: no

## Summary

An `app` page that declares `PageSchema.record` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24265, landed as `ef65646843`) now reads that ONE row, and every component `visibleWhen` on the page reads it as `record`. No root is added: a count is a `summary` roll-up field on the row (`record.env_count >= 2`) and a tier is the object's own field (`record.plan != 'free'`).

## How

- **`PageView.tsx`.** `appPageRecordBinding` picks the binding up on `type: 'app'` only, and only when it names an object. `AppPageRecord` returns its children untouched when there is none: no gate, no read, no scope. With a binding, `ElementDataSourceGate` resolves it, as `ParentRecordBinding` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` resolves a block's one-row binding. That covers the named view, the filter AND-combined with it, the sort, and the family's panels for an unresolvable view, a refused filter or no adapter. `AppPageRecordRead` then reads `$top: 1` through the page's adapter, under the caller's identity. The filter's placeholder tokens (`{current_org_id}`) resolve through `useResolvedFilter` over `useFilterScope`, as every bound block's do. The read is keyed on the data-invalidation bus for the bound object, so a write re-reads in place.
- **`ExpressionProvider.tsx`.** `PageRecordScope` publishes the ambient predicate scope plus `record`, and nothing else. `buildExpressionScope` is unchanged. Its docblock now says why `record` is not a tier root and where an app page gets it. The row goes into the ambient predicate scope, not into `RecordContextProvider`. That context is the record page's, and the `record:*` blocks read their body from it. Placed there, the page row would become the record of every unbound record block on the page, a binding the spec does not give. A record block that binds its own row still wins for its own subtree, because `buildNodeEvaluationScope` writes `record` after the ambient spread.

## The states (the card's rulings)

- **Pending.** The page body is not drawn until the read settles. This is the convention of the record blocks' one-record binding: `BoundRecordProvider` draws nothing under the row until it lands. Here it is drawn as the page's own loading state (`page-record-loading`). No predicate is evaluated before the row arrives, so no block can show and then hide, or the reverse.
- **0 rows.** `record` is bound as `null`, so `record == null` holds and a field read on it faults. A fail-soft `visibleWhen` renders the component, the same verdict the spec gives an unbound row. A refused read (`classifyLoadError` answers `forbidden`) reads the same way, as `BoundRecordProvider` treats it.
- **Read error.** The page body is not drawn, so it fails closed. The record page's own failed-read state stands in its place (`empty.recordLoadFailed`, same copy and keys) with a Retry that re-runs the same read.
- **No binding, or not an `app` page.** The ambient scope reaches the page as the same object, and nothing is read.

## Verification (app-shell at `bc03904d99`, unchanged at head `43062b27e1`)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`: exit 0. Then `pnpm run type-check` in `packages/app-shell` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the second config includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`: 13 passed. It renders the real `PageView`, the `app` page renderer, `element:text` and `SchemaRenderer`, over a fake adapter whose `find` is counted.
  - (a) tier, on a `free` row and on a `team` row.
  - (b) count, at 1 and at 2.
  - The parsed document gives the same verdicts as the stored one.
  - Exactly one row read per page open, with `$top: 1` and the org token resolved.
  - Controls: no binding (ambient scope identical, zero reads); a `home` page carrying a binding (no read); the scope is the ambient roots plus `record` and nothing else; loading; 0 rows; a 403 read; a failed read and its Retry.
- The test families that name the touched files: the 20 test files that import `PageView` (including `scripts/__tests__/page-key-read-census.test.ts` and `vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts`, which read its source) and the 7 `providers/__tests__` files on `ExpressionProvider`. 27 files, 250 tests, all passed, run with `--maxWorkers=1`.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the objectstack checkout's copy) with its trap restore. In each, the mutation landed as anchor 1 → 0 with the blob changed, and the restore was proven blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - binding removed (`({ ...ambient, record })` → `({ ...ambient })`): 8 failed, 5 passed, including both (a) pins, (b), the parsed pin, scope, loading, 0-row and 403;
  - pending removed (the body renders before the row): 1 failed, the loading pin;
  - fail-closed removed (a failed read renders the body): 1 failed, the read-error pin.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed sources: 0 errors. The narrowing is a measurement, not a skipped run: the population is the changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files the root `eslint.config.js` lints (3), counted from `--format json`. Type-aware linting is not enabled there, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Gate battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations` all exited 0.
- **`check:element-data-source-declaration` exits 0 at `43062b27e1`.** `PageView.tsx` is a named `HOST_EXEMPTIONS` entry (seat ruling `6272155387`):
  - **The file:** a page host resolving the spec-declared `PageSchema.record` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24265). It registers no block.
  - **Self-limiting:** the exemption lapses once the comment-masked file calls `ComponentRegistry.register(` or a bare `register(`.
  - **Stale entries:** an entry whose file no longer consumes the gate exits 2.
  - **Pinned** by the new `scripts/__tests__/check-element-data-source-declaration.test.ts`, 6 passed, on the real `PageView.tsx` text.
  - **Ablation:** with the self-limit removed, 2 failed / 4 passed (both host-plus-registration pins). Restored with blob == HEAD `fc6b1adfd0d7`.
- Round 2 at `43062b27e1`: `type-check:scripts`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check:unreferenced-sources` all exit 0, and `eslint` on the 2 changed scripts reports 0/0. The script gained the canonical `isEntrypoint` guard so its test can import `judgeSite`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell` directory, and the repository-wide lint.

## Hand-off

- objectstack's liveness ledger row for `PageSchema.record` (`liveness/page.json`, `planned`) leaves `planned` only through an objectstack PR. That is not this PR's to move. The renderer half it waits for is this PR.
- The spec's `PageRecordBindingSchema` docblock says zero rows "leaves `record` unbound". This PR binds `null`, per the card's ruling ("`record` is null and predicates read it as absent"). A field read gets the same verdict either way: it faults and the component renders. The two differ only on `record == null`. Seat ruling `6272155387` Q2 A keeps `null`. The docblock wording rides the objectstack liveness hand-off (the `PageSchema.record` row leaves `planned` once this lands).

## Acceptance notes

- The row is read without `$expand` and without the record page's field-level-security strip. Predicates read stored values, and the server strips denied fields itself.
- The interface-mode branch (`interfaceConfig.source`) is not wrapped. A `record` binding is placed on `type: 'app'` pages, and that branch renders `InterfaceListPage`, not regions.
- Nothing is added to the package entry. `PageRecordScope` is a module export of `ExpressionProvider.tsx` and is not re-exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s index.
